stations.title: Theo
stations.say: How many cedar candles are left?

stations.title: Stock room
stations.text: Counts slowly and answers a moment later.

captions: The shop waits on slow things now. Theo asks the stock room how many cedar candles it has.
The laptop prints undefined, and a moment later the stock room counts 4. Too late.
You hand each slow thing a function to call, so the count is used once it arrives.
The stock room answers, your function runs, and the line reaches Theo: 4 in stock.
Code that waits now hands over what to do next, instead of giving an answer back.
